question: Who among the following is associated with the Mridangam instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Palghat Mani Iyer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Palghat Mani Iyer** was an eminent Indian percussionist and a renowned mridangam player.
 
• He is regarded as one of the greatest mridangam players of the 20th century.
 
• Palghat Mani Iyer was known for his mastery over intricate rhythms and his ability to accompany and enhance the performances of many leading Carnatic musicians.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan, one of India's highest civilian honors, for his contributions to Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mridangam**

 
 
• The mridangam is a percussion instrument from India of ancient origin.
 
• It is the primary rhythmic accompaniment in a Carnatic music ensemble, which is a classical music tradition of South India.
 
• The mridangam is a double-headed drum, with each head producing different tones. It is played with the hands and fingers.
 
• The instrument is made from a hollowed piece of jackfruit wood, and the two drumheads are made from layers of animal hide.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Musicians**
 
 
• **Hari Prasad Chaurasia** - A renowned Indian flutist associated with the bansuri, a type of Indian bamboo flute.
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan** - A legendary sarod player, known for his significant contributions to Hindustani classical music.
 
• **Zarin S Sharma** - Although not widely recognized in the context of Indian classical music, this name does not relate to the mridangam.
